1.

Not the blood of offerings, which flowed Upon the Jewish altar stone, Was sufficient (our conscience knows it) To cleanse the soul.

2.

No, Christ Himself, God’s Lamb, Has taken away our sin. One single offering He brought forth; His blood was sufficient.

3.

Our soul looks back Upon the burden, which He bore. Once He died, He dies no more, Upon the tree of the cross it was.

4.

We look forward with joy, For He, who has suffered, Shall descend from heaven’s height With wondrous salvation.

5.

May eternal thanks and praise And glory be borne forth To Him, who stands in the midst of the throne, The slain Lamb of God!
